note: baseline after worker start: no diff yet

delegate Lead->Bo: unassigned child NWR-202 assigned later. Not handoffs: top-level NWR-205 picked up, child NWR-207 picked up under an unassigned parent, NWR-204 created for the parent's own assignee
return Ada->Lead: child NWR-203 done. Not handoffs: NWR-204 done by the parent's own assignee, NWR-208 done under an unassigned parent, NWR-210 done under an unlisted parent, a status change
NWR-202 reassigned and done in one poll: reassign Bo->Cy, then return Cy->Lead. NWR-203 staying done sends nothing
return Cy->Lead: NWR-207 done in the same poll its parent got an assignee (the parent's assignee is read from this poll). The parent picked up from nobody is top-level: no envelope
return Ada->Lead again: NWR-203 moved to done a second time. Not a handoff: NWR-209 done and unassigned in the same poll (no sender)
